name: progress-wipe-bar
prompt: Shader layer: a thin loading bar along the bottom that fills from left to right over the layer's duration. Everything else must be transparent so it can sit over footage.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader layer that draws a 6 px bar along the bottom edge. It fills left to right using iProgress, and every pixel outside the bar is fully transparent. It's not compiled or rendered yet: no live Powermove tools were attached to this run. The bar's colour is output with alpha already applied (premultiplied); if the bar's edges look dark over footage, Powermove expects straight alpha instead. You can change the height, side margin, distance from the bottom, fill colour, track colour and opacity, and overall opacity in the Inspector. The track is the faint part of the bar that hasn't filled yet; set its opacity to 0 to hide it.
